stem: In a class activity, Meena lists four jobs done in the stomach: (1) churning food by wall movements, (2) breaking down proteins, (3) killing many harmful bacteria, (4) protecting the stomach lining. She must match each job to the correct secretion or action. Which matching is correct?

options.text: 1 – mucus, 2 – acid, 3 – digestive juice enzymes, 4 – churning
1 – wall movements, 2 – digestive juice enzymes, 3 – acid, 4 – mucus
1 – wall movements, 2 – acid, 3 – mucus, 4 – digestive juice enzymes
1 – digestive juice enzymes, 2 – wall movements, 3 – mucus, 4 – acid

teacher.key_rationale: Churning is done by wall movements; protein breakdown is done by digestive juice enzymes; acid kills many harmful bacteria; mucus protects the stomach lining from acid. Only option B matches all four correctly.
